title: ECB Survey of Professional Forecasters, Q4 2026 — the professional-forecaster read on the terminal rate, one day after the 10-29 decision
source: EST: ecb.europa.eu Survey of Professional Forecasters index (stats/ecb_surveys/survey_of_professional_forecasters/html/index.en.html), fetched direct 2026-09-10 (HTTP 200) — the page states the date verbatim and flags it itself: 'The next release will be published on 30 October 2026 (provisional)'. Cadence corroborated on the same page's previous-releases list, which puts the Q3 2026 round at 24 July 2026 (published as press release ecb.pr260724, i.e. the day after the 23 July Governing Council Day 2) and runs one round per quarter. The PROVISIONAL word is the ECB's own, and it is the reason this is filed estimate quite apart from the taxonomy: a provisional date may move. Filed estimate on the taxonomy count as well — market-events-data.ts's confirmed-prefix list (IR:/CAL:/BLS:/FED:/PJM:/SEC:/TSY:/OCC:/BEA:/CENSUS:/ISM:/CB:/UMICH:/FHFA:) carries no slot for a non-Fed central bank, the same reason ecb-decision-2026-09-10, ecb-account-2026-10-08 and ecb-economic-bulletin-2026-09-24 are all estimate despite direct ECB primaries, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-10
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-10 by the ecb-decision-2026-09-10 D-0 post-decision pulse-check adjacency sweep. WHY IT WAS WORTH PROPOSING, stated narrowly: the parent ledger's one durable claim (FT-ecb-decision-2026-09-10-2) is a bet that ~65 economists beat the futures strip on where ECB rates stop, and on 2026-09-10 that disagreement widened rather than resolved — the ECB delivered 25bp to a 2.50% deposit rate (effective 09-16) and simultaneously raised its own staff HICP path to 3.0/2.5/2.1 for 2026/27/28 on a LOWERED Brent assumption ($89.5/$78.0/$73.6 vs June's $96.9/$82.2/$77.1), after which money markets moved to ~85bp of further tightening by end-2027 from just under 70bp, with December fully priced. The SPF is the only DATED instrument on this calendar that re-measures the forecaster side of that exact gap on a published cadence, and Q4 lands 10-30, the day after the 2026-10-29 decision — so it reads the professionals AFTER they have seen whether October delivered. IMPACT LOW AND SYMBOLS EMPTY, deliberately and on the parent's own reasoning rather than by default: no house playbook is rates-keyed, no tracked name carries euro-rates exposure, and a survey of forecasters is a measurement of opinion, not a policy action — it moves no rate and settles no auction. It is a scoreboard for a ledger claim, which is exactly the weight LOW is for. Whoever researches it should note the contamination risk on the date and not credit the SPF with anything: 10-30 sits one day after an ECB decision whose own presser is the price event, and the euro month-end index rebalance falls in the same window. Estimate; it widens caution and licenses nothing, and the ECB's own 'provisional' label means the date itself must be re-checked before any assessment leans on it.
